title: USV Analyst Program 2026
content:
APPLY NOW

Two weeks ago we pre-announced that we would be kicking off a new Analyst program this year. USV has had analysts since the firm first started in 2004, and that post gives some helpful context on how the program is evolving. Applications for the new analyst class are now live. The rest of the post will discuss what the program is, how to apply, and some FAQs.

Analysts at USV are full members of the investment team. They are actively involved in all team meetings and, alongside the rest of the team, are expected to help source and diligence investments, develop thesis ideas, and support the portfolio. We are a very small team, so the role requires a high degree of initiative and there is often not a lot of structure. In return, it offers significant autonomy from day one and an opportunity to learn a tremendous amount. More than any specific experience, we look for people who have deep curiosity, who have passion for exploring new ideas, and who enjoy building relationships with other technologists.

Just as in the past, we are running a completely open application process. There is no inside track for people with connections. The application is fairly involved as it includes 5 written answers and 2 recorded videos. Given the volume of applicants we expect to receive we are keeping the process tight. All applications must be received by Sunday, June 14th, 2026 at midnight ET. There will be no exceptions. We will attempt to review all applications by mid-July. From the initial submissions, we’ll select a smaller group for video interviews and then a set of finalists for in-person meetings. We currently expect the process to be finished by the end of August and candidates should be available to start work in September of 2026 in either New York City or San Francisco.

Below is a list of frequently asked questions, which we will occasionally update:

FAQs

  1. How long is the analyst program?
    This is a fixed term program lasting two years
  2. How many analysts are you hiring?
    Two analysts
  3. What do analysts do after the program?
    Past analysts have joined other venture firms, gone to startups, founded their own companies and funds, and entered government. We’re really proud of the paths they’ve taken.
  4. When will you make offers?
    We expect to make offers in late August (2026). Applicants should be available to start work in September of 2026.
  5. What prior experience/education is required?
    We don’t have any specific requirements. We have a preference for applicants with between 1-5yrs of work experience, but we will look at all applications. No previous venture capital experience is required.
  6. What does USV invest in?
    USV manages two funds at a time — a core fund which invests in early stage (primarily seed and series A) opportunities and an “opportunity” fund where we invest in opportunities both in and out of the existing portfolio.
  7. Do analysts work with a specific partner?
    Analysts work collaboratively across the entire team. Everyone has the opportunity to spend meaningful time across any of four main domains: AI, energy, crypto, bio.
  8. What makes a good analyst?
    A high degree of curiosity, interest in learning new topics and skills, working well in teams, being a self starter, enjoying actively developing your network.
  9. Where is the position based?
    We are an in-person team all based in NY. However, this analyst class will be expected to spend meaningful time in SF.
  10. Can foreign nationals apply?
    Unfortunately we can only consider applicants who already have a US work permit.
  11. How do I apply?
    By submitting an application.
  12. What is the application deadline?
    June 14th, 2026 at midnight ET
  13. Where can I ask more questions?
    Email AnalystProgram2026@usv.com. One of us or one of our agents will respond.
